name: Coverage this quarter
means: $10.2M of pipeline dated this quarter against $2.1M of quota still to close. The usual target is 3x.

name: Coverage to match last quarter
means: Matching last quarter's $9.8M means closing $8.0M more. There's $10.2M dated this quarter to do it with.

name: Coverage next quarter
means: $9.5M is dated for next quarter against $4.0M of quota. Early in a quarter, 2x for the next one is healthy.

name: New pipeline created
means: $32.7M created in the last 90 days vs $30.7M in the 90 before. Pipeline built now is next quarter's bookings.

name: Deals stuck in stage
means: 128 open deals ($12.0M) have sat in their stage longer than 3 in 4 winning deals in the same segment did.

name: Close date already passed
means: 99 open deals ($13.9M) have a close date before this quarter. They can't be forecast until a rep re-dates them.

name: Owned by reps who left
means: No open deals belong to the two reps who left. Their deals were reassigned.

name: Deals pushed at least once
means: 91 of 413 open deals have been pushed. Pushed deals have won 45% of the time vs 34% for the rest.

name: Top 5 deals' share
means: The 5 biggest deals dated this quarter are 20% of its pipeline. Above a third, one loss moves the number a lot.

name: Win rate trend
means: 37% of deals won in the last two quarters vs 34% in the two before.
